question_evidence_quote: He drank nine liters of water on Monday, Thursday and Saturday and 8 liters of water on Tuesday, Friday and Sunday.
observed_error: The six listed daily amounts are added incorrectly as 49 liters.
violated_condition: The known six-day intake equals 9 + 9 + 9 + 8 + 8 + 8 = 51 liters.
error_description: The response correctly lists the six known daily amounts but evaluates 9 + 9 + 9 + 8 + 8 + 8 as 49 liters instead of 51 liters. This understates the intake excluding Wednesday; the subsequent subtraction from 60 liters correctly uses that erroneous subtotal.
